title: Reckoner strategies (v2)
description: A centred section on linen paper: a small boxed eyebrow, a calm 32px statement whose last words turn tan, then a centred pair of square, sand-outlined cards, each with a 120px artwork slot, a 22px title, one line of grey text and a sand 'learn more' button. The statement fades in as it scrolls into view; cards fill with a pale sand tint on hover over half a second.
notes: the reveal is a CSS scroll-driven animation (no JavaScript); browsers without it show the text in place
media slots are 120×120 placeholders until filled
best with one to three cards
